note.fr: Un test de connaissances et un test de personnalité sont requis pour l'admission.
note.en: A knowledge test and a personality test are required for admission.

evidence.quote: We use the knowledge test to assess your mathematical and logical-analytical abilities as well as your problem-solving skills, which are necessary for successfully completing your studies. This part of the selection procedure takes about 30 minutes. The personality test is a self-assessment of your suitability for the business or law degree programme at EBS Universität.

note.fr: Un entretien de sélection personnel de 30 minutes est requis.
note.en: A 30-minute personal selection interview is required.

evidence.quote: Personal selection interview In order to get to know you personally and to be able to assess you even better, we conduct a 30-minute individual interview.

notes: The tuition fee quote is from the EBS Fees Schedule for the Bachelor in Law, Politics and Economics. The amount is per semester; the annual cost is EUR 14,680. The application process is not via uni-assist; the university's own application portal is used, as indicated by the German page.
